name: Module 18×25 castellated, 38 pads
description: An original synthetic castellated radio module in round numbers: 18 × 25 × 3.2 mm, 14 + 10 + 14 pads at 1.27 mm, a 3 × 3 ground array and a 6 mm antenna end.
note: Estimated: an original synthetic module, not any product's; a module's datasheet gives its mechanical drawing and recommended land pattern.

name: ESP32-S31-WROOM-3
description: Espressif ESP32-S31-WROOM-3: 22 × 30 × 3.5 mm LGA module, 25 + 22 + 25 + 22 pads at 0.85 mm, a 3 × 3 ground array turned 45° (pad 95), four corner pads (96–99) and a 6 mm antenna end.

citation.document: Espressif ESP32-S31-WROOM-3 & ESP32-S31-WROOM-3U Datasheet (pre-release), Figure 10-1 module dimensions and Figure 11-1 PCB land pattern

note: The pad rows, pitch, outline and land pattern are the datasheet's (Figure 10-1, p. 64; Figure 11-1, p. 67); the ground array's turn and pitch were checked against Espressif's published footprint and STEP model, used as a dimension source only. The ground pad nearest the antenna is chamfered on the module; it is drawn square. The can size, board thickness and antenna meander are estimated.

name: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1
description: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1: 18 × 25.5 × 3.1 mm castellated module, 14 + 12 + 14 pads at 1.27 mm, a 3 × 3 ground array (pad 41), a 15.8 × 17.6 mm shield can and a 6 mm PCB antenna end.

citation.document: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U Datasheet, Figure 10-1 module dimensions and Figure 11-1 recommended PCB land pattern

note: Outline, height, board thickness, pad rows (0.85 × 0.9 mm at 1.27 mm, pin 1 7.49 mm below the antenna edge, the bottom row from 2.015 mm), castellations (Ø0.55), the 3 × 3 ground array (0.9 mm pads in a 3.7 mm square, centred 7.5 mm from the left edge and 10.29 mm from the bottom), the can (15.8 × 17.6 mm, read 1.05 mm above the bottom edge) and the lands (1.5 × 0.9 mm, 0.5 mm beyond the edge; Figure 11-1, p. 45) from the datasheet. The antenna meander's trace, inset and turns are estimated from the top view; the emboss groove is estimated.

name: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U
description: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U: 18 × 19.2 × 3.2 mm castellated module without a PCB antenna, 14 + 12 + 14 pads at 1.27 mm, a 3 × 3 ground array (pad 41), a 15.65 × 17.5 mm shield can notched at its +x +y corner for a U.FL (MHF I) antenna receptacle 3 mm from the right edge and 2.46 mm from the top.

citation.document: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U Datasheet, Figure 10-2 module dimensions and Figure 11-2 recommended PCB land pattern

note: Outline (18 × 19.2 mm), height (3.2 mm), board thickness, pad rows (0.85 × 0.9 mm at 1.27 mm, pin 1 1.19 mm below the top edge, the bottom row from 2.015 mm), castellations (Ø0.55), the 3 × 3 ground array (0.9 mm pads in a 3.7 mm square, centred 7.5 mm from the left edge and 10.29 mm from the bottom), the can (15.65 × 17.5 mm, 1.1 mm above the bottom edge, its notch 4.9 × 4.4 mm from the 10.75 mm and 13.1 mm sections), the U.FL receptacle's centre (3 mm from the right edge, 2.46 mm from the top) and the lands (1.5 × 0.9 mm, 0.5 mm beyond the edge; Figure 11-2, p. 46) from the datasheet; the pads are the WROOM-1's at the same distance from the bottom edge. The can is centred across, as read from the top view (within 0.1 mm); the receptacle's body (2.6 mm square base, Ø2 mm shell, 1.25 mm tall) is a U.FL / MHF I receptacle's typical size, estimated.
